# DUKAAN

> Contemporary unisex clothing engineered with pure European linen, soft cotton gauze, and timeless comfortable silhouettes. Objects of everyday expression handcrafted for longevity, breathability, and tropical climates.

DUKAAN is an independent slow-fashion atelier rooted in architectural tailoring, pure natural fibers (Normandy flax linen, double-gauze cotton, botanical twill), and transparent craftsmanship. We engineer garments specifically designed for hot and humid climates while maintaining elevated European tailoring standards.

## Core Collections & Categories

- [Complete Wardrobe](https://dukaan-j5l5.vercel.app/shop): Full collection of pure linen overshirts, camp-collar shirts, pleated trousers, and modular co-ords.
- [Men's Edit](https://dukaan-j5l5.vercel.app/men): Unstructured tailoring, relaxed linen shirts, and breathable trousers.
- [Women's Edit](https://dukaan-j5l5.vercel.app/women): Fluid botanical dresses, oversized linen tops, and breathable gauze sets.
- [Collection 04: Solstice Edition](https://dukaan-j5l5.vercel.app/collections/solstice-edition): High-summer architectural linen and Mediterranean geometries.
- [Collection 03: Terra Monochrome](https://dukaan-j5l5.vercel.app/collections/terra-monochrome): Raw earth pigments, mineral clay washes, and heavy corduroy.
- [Editorial Journal & Blog](https://dukaan-j5l5.vercel.app/blog): Technical monographs on textile botany, linen care manuals, and capsule wardrobe architecture.

## Key Materials & Specifications

- **Normandy Flax Linen**: Certified European Flax®, 260 GSM slub weave, dew-retted naturally without caustic chemicals. Highly thermoregulating and moisture-wicking.
- **Double Gauze Cotton**: 100% long-staple organic cotton woven in dual breathable plies, creating an insulating air cushion that prevents garment clinging in high humidity.
- **Botanical Twill & Corduroy**: High-durability natural weaves pre-washed for zero post-purchase shrinkage and immediate tactile softness.
